import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import { expect, fn } from 'storybook/test';

import { Probe } from './Probe';

const shared = { test: { restoreMocks: false } };
const meta = {
  title: 'ResetCases/F10',
  component: Probe,
  parameters: shared,
} satisfies Meta<typeof Probe>;
export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>;
export const First: Story = {
  args: { getValue: fn().mockReturnValue('stubbed') },
  
  play: async ({ canvas }) => {
    await expect(canvas.getByTestId('value')).toHaveTextContent('stubbed');
  },
};
export const Second: Story = { ...First };
